Method of Attack: deserialization vulnerability leading to remote code execution
exploitation via ysoserial to upload and execute binaries in a single deserialization call
Discoverer: Johannes Ullrich of the SANS Internet Storm Center
Impacted Systems: web applications built with Struts using Commons FileUpload library
Attack Vector: vulnerable Commons FileUpload library used by Struts framework
Indicators of Compromise: presence of Commons FileUpload library version prior to 1.3.3 in WEB-INF/lib directory
